```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
if (!exists("SRS.PGA.units", inherits = FALSE)) SRS.PGA.units <- "g"
SRS.performance.target <- TRUE
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "summary", "srs.R"))
```

The compatibility check was evaluated after the final suite scaling. In the
delivered suite, `r SRS_PERFORMANCE$final.inside` of the checked
record-period ordinates fall within the compatibility envelope, and the largest
remaining relative deviation outside that envelope is
`r SRS_PERFORMANCE$final.maxViolation`. As a process audit, the median
record-level RMSE decreased from `r SRS_PERFORMANCE$rmse.start` before modal
adjustment to `r SRS_PERFORMANCE$rmse.final` after adjustment.
